create_NgramProposer: create an NgramProposer instance initialized with a VllmConfig for speculative decoding
run_NgramProposer_propose: run the NgramProposer.propose method to generate draft token IDs from sampled token sequences
run_NgramProposer_batch_propose: run the NgramProposer.batch_propose method to generate draft tokens for multiple requests in parallel
run_batch_propose_numba: run the batch_propose_numba function to execute parallel n-gram matching across a batch of requests
run_find_longest_matched_ngram: run _find_longest_matched_ngram_and_propose_tokens to find the longest matching n-gram and extract draft tokens
